jurisdiction: EDPA (Eswatini Data Protection Authority - the Eswatini Communications Commission)
key_requirements: Controllers must notify/register with the Commission before processing (registration window 1 March-30 September 2024); lawful processing and data subject rights; enforcement notices with show-cause periods
enforcement_authority: Eswatini Data Protection Authority (EDPA) / Eswatini Communications Commission (ESCCOM)
penalties_range: Administrative: E5M or 2% of annual turnover; criminal: E100M or 5% of turnover or up to 10 years imprisonment (secondary source, s. 53 unverified) (unconfirmed)
notes: Gazette Extraordinary No. 41 Vol. LX of 2022-03-04; s. 1(2) in operation on publication; other sources mention 23 Aug 2022 or enforcement from Sept 2025 (conflicting)
